Body.Content:
Azure Security Center, which helps customers protect workloads running in Azure against cyber threats, can also be used to secure workloads running on-premises and in other clouds. Managing security across increasingly distributed infrastructure is complex and can create gaps that attackers can exploit. Security Center will reduce this complexity by unifying security management across environments, and by providing intelligent threat protection using analytics and the Microsoft Intelligent Security Graph. Security Center has also released new capabilities to enable central management of security policies, better detect and defend against advanced threats, and streamline investigation of threats.

Learn more at the Azure Security Center blog.

 

See the Azure Security Center page for product information.
